name: Eris
description: Eris, the secretary: her status poses, a conversation typed to her, and the soul text and orb other plugins reuse.

endue.eris.shortcut.description: The key that summons Eris from any app (Option+Enter on macOS): on the island over other apps, in the desk while it is in front. DESK_ERIS_SHORTCUT overrides it. The tray's Talk to Eris works whatever the key.
